yield_case_schema.name: YieldCase
yield_case_schema.ux_contract: P50 editable, P90 editable independently. Ratio is derived display-only field. No enum lock — both values are free numeric inputs.

price_curve_schema.name: PriceCurve

fields.label: str — display name
fields.calendar_start_year: int — first year of the time series
fields.values_eur_mwh: list[float] — ordered annual EUR/MWh values from calendar_start_year

price_curve_schema.ux_contract: Named curve library. CRUD operations on the library. Selector chooses one entry by curve_id. No hardcoded curve names in engine.

revenue_case_selection_schema.name: RevenueCaseSelection
revenue_case_selection_schema.ux_contract: Scenario tab exposes two selectors: Equity curve and Sizing curve. Both reference the named library. Engine uses sizing_curve_id for bank-case CFADS evaluation.

scenario_tab_contract.note: Scenario tab aggregates the YieldCase and RevenueCaseSelection inputs. No project-name dispatch. Generic for any solar/wind + optional BESS project.

technology_specific_streams.note: Technology-specific streams are configured via the project's RevenueParams. No hardcoded stream logic in the generic scenario contract.
